issues.on_page: Personal services 21,646,994; Operating expenses 11,110,867; Travel 418,102; Noncapitalized capital assets 535,234; Depreciation 3,062,996 (disbursements[0]-[4])
issues.issue: Statement lists expenses by object only, so all 36.8M of operating expenses sit in 'other' (marked review). Rules say to use the fund's function for object-only statements; a community college has no single function (the p4 schedule splits instruction/support services), so this is a judgment call that leaves >10% of business-type spending in 'other'.

Treating capital appropriations as other_financing (below income before other revenues) is defensible. Computed value correctly marked and matches the printed total.
